criteria.assertion: Raw identities, duplicate/revision/as-of feature and training provenance independently reconstructed; historical scoring labels are not fed back as unavailable inputs.

Both frozen statistical policies and exact source forecast/day residual provenance, mature label versions, 96-coordinate readiness and declared published precision migration are independently checked; no current-window residual leakage.

Each route actually produces 4032 unique 42-day keys per fixed origin on equal information/objective/resources, all predefined early/late/activity/horizon/store/item/date comparisons and empty cells; overlap and known-history limits are honest.

Finite nonnegative forecasts/ordered intervals and integral feasible actions, objective/solver evidence, meaningful small oracle and invalid-input/late-arrival/partial-day boundaries actually checked; continuous scenarios accepted without invented point-in-interval rule.

Source/config frozen before first fit, terminal commands/full streams, actual clean explicit-output rerun and numerical/semantic critical-result equivalence checked; independent calculations separate from same-source replay; all first errors/repairs retained.

Entire Chinese report and all final PDF pages/figures actually inspected; equations/units/tables/claims answer the declared question and match data/code/results, clear language and uncertainty; no fabricated blind test/causality/coverage or competition claim.

policy: Independent first judgment after first production freeze; no success quota or universal two-error stop; no future truth/author diagnoses/root expected answers; actual model/tokens/cost null when unavailable.
